We’re expanding our campus team and selecting ambitious students across Barcelona universities (UPF, ESADE, UB, TBS, UIC, Erasmus & beyond) to represent La French on campus.

What you get as a La French Campus Ambassador:
🥂 Free VIP entry to all our weekly club nights & boat parties (Opium, Downtown, Sutton & more)
🍾 Complimentary VIP tables & bottle packages for you and your friends
💶 Uncapped cash commissions on every ticket and table booking (€200 – €800+/month)
🌐 Direct access to Barcelona’s largest international community of students & nightlife pros

Your missions:
1️⃣ Represent La French across your campus and student groups
2️⃣ Bring your crew and classmates on the VIP guest list
3️⃣ Attend our parties, vibe at VIP tables, and capture content

posts.caption:
We came for a 72-hour holiday.
That was 8 months ago.

We arrived knowing nobody with one suitcase and zero plans.
Now our camera rolls are 90% blur and 100% pure joy.
70+ different nationalities, all screaming the exact same beat under the laser lights.

Was it just another night out?
Not even close.

This is our youth. Live it while you’re young.
See you on the floor tonight. 🔥
